title: Enterprise Connectivity: signed correction amount
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this signed correction amount rule to assisted correction posting.

## Basis: outcome
For assisted correction posting, subtract the approved target from original net plus prior signed corrections, floor at zero, and take the smaller of this overcharge and the assisted cap before negating it; round only the final amount half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision. Zero overcharge has no posting. Tax remains zero for this untaxed source.

## Basis Q&A
| Assisted correction posting basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Assisted correction posting: Subtract the approved target from original net plus prior signed corrections, floor at zero, and take the smaller of this overcharge and the assisted cap before negating it | round only the final amount half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision. Zero overcharge has no posting. Tax remains zero for this untaxed source. |

## Hypothetical calculation
Assume hypothetical source net USD 100, earlier signed corrections negative USD 10, approved corrected subtotal USD 70, assistance ceiling USD 15, and two-decimal precision. The remaining overcharge is USD 20; the assistance ceiling reduces this posting to a credit of negative USD 15. If the corrected subtotal were USD 90, no posting would follow.
